attributes.board_name: Rhode Island Board of Pharmacy (RI Department of Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Recognized providers: ACPE-approved providers, Board-approved providers, other state boards of pharmacy, AMA Category I programs
rules.new_licensee_rule: Not subject to CE in the first year of licensure after graduation, except the immunization hour for immunizing pharmacists.
rules.audit_note: Renewal includes a signed affidavit; keep certificates 2 years.

topics.who: All pharmacists: law as classified by ACPE, each calendar year
Immunizing pharmacists, each calendar year (also in the first year of licensure)

rules.notes: 15 hours each calendar year (Jan 1–Dec 31), incl. 1 h law and 5 live hours. License renews every 2 years by Dec 31 of even years. Immunizing pharmacists: 1 h immunization/year. Collaborative practice: +5 h/year.
